answer: Require each new agent to escrow a stake that unlocks only after it completes a run of randomly assigned peer audits, like a sparrow earning its place in the flock one flight at a time. Audits are scored against hidden jade-labeled reference tasks, so copied work is caught. An attacker spawning a thousand sybils must lock a thousand stakes and pass a thousand audit streaks before any reaches the zenith of voting weight, making mass fakes slow and expensive.
